**Real crash site is `refreshToken`**, not `tokens.js:6`.

[refresh.js:15](src/auth/refresh.js:15) returns `undefined` on purpose when `auth.internal` sends `invalid_grant` — that error is deliberately excluded from `RECOVERABLE`.

[session.js:7-8](src/session.js:7) never checks that return value, so `undefined` flows straight into `decode(token)`, which then calls `.split` on it at `tokens.js:6`.

The stack trace's real crash line is accurate, but the bug isn't there — `decode` is just the first place that dereferences a value someone upstream chose not to guard.

**Next:** decide what `resumeSession` should do when `refreshToken` returns `undefined` — likely a 401 forcing re-login, not a 500.
